about.title: About Us
intro: Eskisehir Technical University Aeronautics and Aerospace Club (ESTU AERO) is a student community that brings together engineering students interested in aviation and space, supporting their technical and social development.

Our club aims to help members take an active role in their career journeys, strengthen their connections with the industry and build their engineering skills. To this end, we organize technical training, seminars, summits, project work and technical trips.
Going beyond theory, ESTU AERO aims to build an ecosystem where students can solve real engineering problems through project teams.
We work to raise individuals who embrace aviation culture and think like engineers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At ESTU Aeronautics and Aerospace Club (ESTU AERO) we care about the privacy of your personal data. This notice explains what data we collect through this website, why and how we process it, and your rights under the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK).

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller for personal data collected on this site is ESTU Aeronautics and Aerospace Club, a student club operating within Eskisehir Technical University.
Contact: estuucakveuzaykulubu@gmail.com

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
paragraphs: Contact form: your name, email address, (optional) phone number, and the subject and content of your message.
Newsletter subscription: your email address and language preference.
Technical data: the services that host the site and provide bot protection may process technical records such as IP address and browser information for security purposes.
Membership applications are not collected on this site but through Google Forms; the data you share there is subject to the terms stated in that form.
Certificates: if a certificate is issued for an event you attended, your full name, email address, the event name and date. Your email address is only used to send you your certificate.

sections.title: 3. Purposes and legal basis
paragraphs: We process contact form data to reply to your message and resolve your request, based on the explicit consent you give when submitting the form.
We process newsletter data to send you our events and announcements by email, based on the explicit consent you give when subscribing.
We process technical data to keep the site secure and prevent abuse, based on legitimate interest.

We process certificate data to issue and deliver your certificate and to let third parties (e.g. employers) verify that it is genuine. Anyone with the Credential ID can see your full name, the event name and date on the verification page; your email address is never shown.

sections.title: 4. Service providers
paragraphs: We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising. To run the site we rely on the following service providers, whose servers may be located abroad:

Vercel (hosting), Google Firebase (storing the newsletter subscriber list), Resend (sending newsletter emails), Web3Forms (delivering contact form messages to us), hCaptcha (bot protection on the contact form), Google Maps (the map on the contact page).
We also use Vercel Blob (storing magazine and certificate files).

sections.title: 5. Retention
paragraphs: Contact form messages are kept for up to 2 years after your request is resolved.
Newsletter subscription data is kept until you unsubscribe, and deleted when you do.
Certificate records are kept indefinitely so they remain verifiable. You may request that your certificate be deleted or revoked.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
paragraphs: This site does not use advertising or analytics cookies. Your browser's local storage only holds a timestamp used to prevent repeated form submissions. Embedded services such as hCaptcha and Google Maps may use their own cookies.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: Under Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the right to learn whether your personal data is processed, to request information about it, to learn the purpose of processing, to request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data, to request deletion or destruction, and to object to processing.
To exercise these rights or to unsubscribe from the newsletter, email us at estuucakveuzaykulubu@gmail.com. We respond within 30 days at the latest.

sections.title: 8. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this notice when necessary. The current version is always published on this page.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By using this website, you agree to the terms below.

sections.title: 1. About the site
paragraphs: This site was created to introduce Eskisehir Technical University Aeronautics and Aerospace Club (ESTU AERO), announce its events and enable communication. The views and content on the site belong to the club and do not represent the official position of Eskisehir Technical University.

sections.title: 2. Use of content
paragraphs: The texts, images and logos on the site belong to ESTU AERO or the respective rights holders. You may share them for personal, non-commercial purposes with attribution; any other use requires permission.

sections.title: 3. Accuracy of information
paragraphs: We try to keep the content current and accurate, but event dates, venues and other details may change without notice. Please contact us for confirmed information.

sections.title: 4. External links
paragraphs: The site links to external sites such as social media accounts and application forms. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those sites.

sections.title: 5. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You must use the contact form and newsletter subscription only for their intended purpose. Attempts to damage the site, gain unauthorized access or abuse the forms are prohibited.

sections.title: 6. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The site is provided "as is". We do not guarantee that it will operate without interruption or error, and we cannot be held liable for indirect damages arising from its use.

sections.title: 7. Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update these terms when necessary. For questions: estuucakveuzaykulubu@gmail.com
